DEVELOPMENT CASE STUDY / 07

Helping a development team establish itself

Organisationeg Solutions
Project dates2007 – 2009
RoleTeam Lead, employed role

THE WORK

Two years of hands-on team leadership and graduate developer training in Johannesburg.

Historical software development experience.

The requirement

eg Solutions was establishing an offshore development team in Johannesburg and needed technical leadership and support for graduate developers.

Our contribution

During a two-year secondment, We managed a small graduate development team, providing on-the-job training and working across the software development lifecycle.

What the assignment involved

Team leadership combined with practical development and training in an enterprise software environment. The assignment formed part of our earlier 2005–2011 employed experience with eg Solutions.

Why this experience matters

Technical change depends on people being able to work confidently with new approaches. The same teaching and leadership experience is relevant when helping a team introduce AI into its development workflow.
